question: Why should devotees of the elephant-enemy have any fear from enemies?
premises: The addressed is called the enemy of elephants
Enemies pose no cause for fear to such devotees
inference: There is no fear from enemies for the devotees of the elephant-enemy.
uncertainties: karivairiṇa is a conventional epithet; specific deity identity not explicit
plain_english: O enemy of elephants, what fear from enemies is there for those who serve you?
